Hi Karthik — great to hear from you. Welcome aboard.

Attached is the Lumenix PO template and our vendor enrollment form. A few notes: 

- Standard term for new vendors is Net 45 (we moved to Net 45 earlier this year).
- We do have an early-pay program: 1.0% discount if invoice is paid within 10 days. Enrollment is simple — we need a signed PO and the vendor banking details for ACH enrollment. There’s a monthly cap of USD 75k per vendor under the program (we can discuss exceptions).
- Required fields: EIN/TIN, remittance address, and a primary AP contact. Please include your company W-9 (or W-8 if outside US).

I can route the PO to our legal if you’d like a quick review of the standard indemnity clause — otherwise we can push a PO through to you by end of day Monday pending tax docs.

Attachments: Lumenix_PO_Template.pdf (pdf), Lumenix_Vendor_Form.docx (docx)

Best,
Anna Ruiz

Karthik — quick finance read: 

- Net45 is acceptable for this pilot given expected monthly spend (~$40k). It improves cash flow for Lumenix but keeps our burn predictable.
- Early-pay at 1% for payment in 10 days should be evaluated on a per-invoice basis. If we assume monthly spend of $40k, 1% is $400/mo — acceptable for faster vendor satisfaction on pilot.
- Recommend we enroll in early-pay but set a procurement cap at $50k/month for automatic early-pay eligibility. Anything above that should route to treasury for manual approval.
- Ops (Priyom) please map the incoming PO fields to our AP system (especially the remittance address and ACH instructions).

If legal flags any PO language, hold enrollment until redlines are resolved.

-Marissa
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>

Karthik / Marissa — a couple legal notes after a quick skim of the Lumenix PO template: 

1) Indemnity: Lumenix’s standard indemnity is a little broad for a small integration pilot. I’ll propose a mutual indemnity carve-in for third-party IP and remove the unlimited liability language.
2) Payment terms: their early-pay program is fine operationally, but we should not pre-authorize any ACH debit on the vendor side. Ensure their enrollment process keeps payment initiation with Lumenix AP (we will only sign enrollment that documents Lumenix retains control).
3) Insurance: confirm the minimum coverage limits — for pilots we can accept the lower tier but get proof of insurance before first invoice.

I’ll draft a short redline and send back to Anna (attached). If Finance is okay with the 1% cap approach, we can accept Net45 + early-pay enrollment once redlines are agreed. 

Attachment: PO_redline_comments.pdf (pdf)

-David
Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference
